user.title: Create a room daylight sensor
user.description: Choose an outdoor illuminance source that already reflects current weather/cloud conditions. Indoor lux sensors are optional supporting inputs; they are ignored while any selected artificial light is on.

data.name: Room name
data.artificial_lights: Lights that invalidate indoor lux readings

window.title: Window {window_number}
window.description: Enter the glazed opening dimensions and outward-facing azimuth. North = 0°, East = 90°, South = 180°, West = 270°. A linked cover is excluded when fully closed; a binary sensor or input boolean is excluded when it is on.
